title: Book by voice
descriptionSignedIn: Talk to the voice assistant: find facilities and free turns, and book in your name.
descriptionSignedOut: Talk to the voice assistant to find facilities and free turns. To book by voice, sign in first.
descriptionGuest: Talk to the voice assistant to find facilities and free turns, and book with your name and phone number.
howItWorks: It will ask for permission to use your microphone. The assistant speaks Galician. A call lasts at most {{minutes}} minutes, and Captions show everything said.

privacy.text: The text of the conversation is sent to {{names}}.
